data.name: CliHelp
data.value: Deneb 2.0 — background download manager Usage: deneb [start|status|pause|resume|stop] [--state-dir PATH] Without a command: connect the interface, starting the background process if needed. Q / Ctrl+C: close interface only. F10: stop Deneb with confirmation. start: start background; status: inspect; pause/resume: global pause only; stop: save and stop. F2: maximum connections per file (applies live), language and settings. --help and --version never start or modify the store.
